name: Sengoku Hime 4 ~Souha Hyakkei, Hana Mamoru Chikai~
original_name: 戦極姫4～争覇百計、花守る誓い～
source:
The fourth installment of the Sengokuhime SLG series takes place after the death of Oda Nobunaga and features 65 female generals and 35 male generals, based both on famous and minor historical figures. New features including naval battles, new battle and domestic affairs skills, a training system and an easy mode for beginners.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/12/01/december-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
《战国姬》SLG系列第四作。故事发生在织田信长死后，收录65名女性武将与35名男性武将，角色既有著名历史人物，也有鲜为人知的人物。

新增海战、新的战斗与内政技能、训练系统，以及适合新手的简单模式。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/12/01/december-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
